title: Focus mode
note: Example of a rule Claude can write on request. Off by default.
css: body::before { content: "focus mode"; position: fixed; z-index: 99999; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font: 11px system-ui; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 3px; background: #c8794f; color: #fff; }
